source: H-Comp Stereo 17.1.42.50 editor, OpenGL frames read back before SwapBuffers (tools/MeterCapture gl=1, 63 fps, design pixels), probes nulltest/make_vu_probe.py and make_vu_cal.py, 2026-10-23

strip.pivot_fit: 800 needle lines, residual median 0.09 px; continuous coordinates (pixel centres at +0.5)

gr.static_check: steady tones: angle = 31.75 + 117.17 g within 1.5 deg (g from audio, makeup removed)
gr.attack: instant (the deepest gain since the last frame)

release.law: two one-poles in cascade on the linear gain

gr.fit: pilot-tone gain (6170 Hz, -54 dBFS) over tones and bursts, thresholds -30 / -20, ratio 4: 97 % of frames within 1 step, rms 0.67 steps

in_out.v: (peak dBFS + 48) / 48, the peak over the frame's interval (sine and square of the same peak read alike)
in_out.law: a rise shows at once and starts a hold decaying from that moment (amplitude, tau); the first drop after a rise shows the level at once unless the hold is higher; every later drop decays toward the level (amplitude, tau) until the next rise
in_out.fit: In: probe, staircase, descending sequences; Out: the reference's own output; 97.5 % of frames within 1 step

lamp.trigger: the output limiter / clip acts (also with Limiter Off: e.g. a -6 dBFS onset with 7.4 dB makeup)

faces.in_out: dBFS: 48 36 24 18 12 6 3 0, 24 at the top, red band 24..0; dividers 14.55 29.45 44.3 51.25 deg; ticks -48.9 -39.2 -29.8 (major) -20.0 -10.3; dots -49.1 -39.3 -19.6 -10.0 (degrees from vertical about the scale centre 320.7, 220.9)
